steps.name: A Friend's Whereabouts (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Soleil] in the "Magic Academy Lobby", then find [Sera] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'm sorry to call you here when you're busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a little time. Lena told me to rest, but I couldn't just sit still.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Lena? Dame Lena Highren of the Silver Claw?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. She's staying at the Guild Alliance inn.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: If she's at the inn, she must be drinking. Did she bring a royal decree?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. She told me to wait a little.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (Her Majesty's business...)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh, adventurer!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina spots %s in the distance and runs over.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I was just thinking of you. I didn't expect to see you here! I must have missed you terribly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-thank you... It's been a while since anyone welcomed me so enthusiastically.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's only been a few days. If you missed the adventurer already, you must be very fond of them, Shiina.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I am! The adventurer deserves it. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I don't recall my junior greeting me quite so enthusiastically when I arrived...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The school was a mess then! Here, I'll hug you instead. Better now?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, yes! Much better!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice to see. Oh, right. Soleil, didn't you need a favor?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I haven't been able to contact Platina lately. I don't know where she is or what she's doing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've seen her a few times at Belpha Library... But not since then.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Could you find her? Whenever she disappears for a while, something has happened.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It might even give you a clue about Her Majesty's decree.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, now I'm curious. I'll look into both, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whom should I ask...? I'll start with Sera at the Guild inn.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Soleil. Stay here until I return. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I will. There's still work to do before the school is in order.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (Soleil and Shiina see %s off until the adventurer vanishes into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: A decree... Is my sister asking the adventurer for something?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I don't know, but it seems important.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I hope it's nothing serious, though it can't be ordinary business.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Probably not. But don't worry. %s will handle it well.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Then, Shiina, shall we get back to tidying up? There's plenty left.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, Soleil!

steps.name: A Friend's Whereabouts (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Leviathan Krill] in the "Song of the Coral" to obtain a <Green Dragon Turtle Crystal>, and [Cupcake Sucre] in the "Monster Tree Mountain Valley" to obtain <Fine Flour>. Then report to Sera in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Ugh, busy, busy. Ingredients to buy, empty wooden beer kegs to fill...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: And I need my pay, but my senior vanished days ago without saying where she was going...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: ...Blank...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: (Sera seems to switch off for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Oh! %s! Were you there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've been standing here for a little while...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Am I that unnoticeable?)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I've been so busy I can't think straight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Too much work can do that.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Do you need anything? Just say the word. You'll have the best service while staying here.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: (Sera's sales smile is so dazzling you can barely keep your eyes open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you're looking for Platina.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: (Sera's eyes suddenly sparkle, and she grasps %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: %s! That's it! We must catch that runaway, exploitative employer... I mean, find my missing senior Platina!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think your true feelings slipped out. Something about an exploitative employer...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Not at all. She's my idol. You must have misheard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Any idea where she might have gone?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Last time I saw her, she mentioned Jiendia and Mirgandia. Wait. Let me remember.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Oh! That's right!

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: She said she'd visit a place called Song of the Coral and Monster Tree Mountain Valley.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I'll look for her there.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Wait. While you're there, could you get these? She said they have good ingredients.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Green Dragon Turtle Crystal and High-Grade Flour.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you for the information!

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Take care!

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: %s, was she there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No sign of Platina. But I got the ingredients.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Thank you. Where on earth has she gone?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hmm. Wait. Let me think.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Remembered?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: It must be that place. What was it called...?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Priests in dragon form live there. She said you can't enter casually.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priests in dragon form...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Apparently, you have to be a Holy Order like Platina to enter. Sniff.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: A Temple Knight like me needs more training.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Now I remember: she said she'd met you there. You know the place, right? Oh, I can't remember the name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xenadia again... I can't remember that place...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Memories of Xenadia linger like faint afterimages.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you think she'd be there?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I'm not sure. But I remember her saying going there to gather her thoughts puts her at ease.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: She probably wouldn't return to the sanctuary, with all its complications... Could you make one more trip?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... I'll go.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Please tell her her poor junior is so short of money she can't buy the equipment she wants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then off to Xenadia...)

steps.name: A Friend's Whereabouts (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Letum] in the "Warriors' Rest" and obtain the <Chronicles of the Velkia Kingdom>. Then deliver them to [Soleil] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: %s, how did you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Found you, Platina!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This is my private spot. Few people know it... Though you know it well too, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't really remember...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You look like you have no idea...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (So the memories are gone, just as Her Majesty said...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Sniff, sniff... You don't remember our thrilling first meeting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think it was like that. (Deadpan.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You don't have to look so serious!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Here's why I came...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Platina that Soleil and Sera are looking for her.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...I see. I owe everyone an apology. Making Soleil search for me again, and causing worry over wages...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Don't worry! I'm Platina the paladin, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For someone in that situation, aren't you acting a little too relaxed?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ahahaha. Does it look that way? Sigh...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I've had a lot on my mind. Before an important battle, I always come here to collect my thoughts.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I thought it was nearly time for Her Majesty to call me. You've probably received a message, too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena said she'd deliver Her Majesty's decree in a few days.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I'm sure it's nothing serious. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone says that, but it always turns out bigger than expected. I'm assuming the same this time.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: With that composure, you'll do fine. I'll go pay Sera soon. But I don't think I'll see Soleil for a while...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pass on a message. What should I say?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's an object, rather than a message... Could you get something on your way and take it to Soleil?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. What is it?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: A book from the Kingdom of Belkia, recently discovered in Mirgandia. It should help with her research.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Look in the cemetery where Belkia's soldiers rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Platina. Take time to gather your thoughts. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Sigh... I wonder if Aurum is doing well...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Your light step tells me you found Platina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I even sorted out the overdue wages.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Pardon? Ah... The Guild Alliance inn. Platina owns it... But what's in your hand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't easy to find. The [Annals of the Kingdom of Belkia].

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (Soleil looks between the book and %s in disbelief.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: How did you...? I'd only heard of it. No one had seen the actual book. Even imperial explorers couldn't find it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Platina said it was recently discovered and asked me to bring it to you.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh, did she?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: She does receive news from the imperial capital faster than I do.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank you. This will help my research greatly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind, may I ask what you're researching?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's complicated, but I'll explain briefly.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Every continent had great mages. In Freios, besides Archmage Xerenis, there was a woman whose name is unknown.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: While other mages served their factions and nations, she belonged to none and fought for those who suffered.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: A young warrior traveled with her. According to a book in Belpha Library, he later went to Eastland and became a Champion.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The mage eventually vanished, but first passed her wishes to someone: a young mage in the Kingdom of Belkia.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: He didn't follow her wishes. Instead, he informed King Letum and began studying her magic separately.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Letum is known as a virtuous king, but he also had powerful ambitions. During that research, they discovered something about the missing woman.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: She had used magic no mage in Freios, human or elf, could wield.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: That's all I know. Please don't repeat it anywhere. The Magic Bureau especially mustn't learn more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: ...I can't tell you that. I'm sorry. I'll explain when I know more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious, but I understand. Thank you, Soleil. I'll be going. See you again.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Take care, %s.
